territorial_scope.description: Municipal measures issued by Shanghai authorities, with municipal-level subsidies for entities in Shanghai.

evidence.quote: 对租用智能算力的主体，市级给予最高30%租金补贴

summary.short: Shanghai municipal measures (issued 28 July 2025) offering subsidies, computing, model and corpus vouchers, R&D, talent and cluster support to AI firms and institutions to expand AI application.
summary.long: The measures were issued by the Shanghai Economic and Informatization Commission on 28 July 2025 and set 12 support measures to expand AI application in Shanghai. Measures 1 to 3 issue computing-power, model and corpus vouchers of 600 million, 300 million and 100 million yuan, with municipal rent subsidies of up to 30% for leased compute, up to 50% of contract value for large-model deployment, and up to 30% for purchased corpora, all capped. Measures 4 and 5 fund key technology and scientific-intelligence projects at up to 30% to 70% of approved investment, capped at 50 million yuan. Measures 6 to 8 support innovation service platforms, new R&D institutions (3 to 5 years, up to 500 million yuan), rewards for product sales or leasing, first-version software applications and demonstration scenarios. Measure 9 covers AI towns and clusters with rent reductions or one-time fees for 6 months to 3 years. Measure 10 provides talent funding and personal awards of up to 300,000 yuan. Measures 11 and 12 cover investment funds and open-source incentives of up to 5 million yuan. The text sets no prohibitions, reporting duties or penalties and works through government subsidies, with implementation left to the issuing bodies.

notes: Administrative notice from the Shanghai Municipal Economic and Informatization Commission setting out 12 measures of subsidies, vouchers, awards and support programmes. The text contains no regulatory obligations, prohibitions, penalties or effective-date clause. All amounts are ceilings (最高) or approved-cost shares. Measure 4 allows up to 50% for strategic or public-welfare projects approved by the municipal government, above the 30% general ceiling in the same measure. The publication date 2025-07-28 appears only in the webpage dateline. The notice header addresses 有关单位 (relevant units) and the measures refer to 企业 and 主体 without a defined eligibility test; 符合条件 (eligible) is not defined in the text. The national new-generation AI strategy is cited as policy background only, with no instrument reference.

obligations.summary: Issue 600 million yuan of compute vouchers and strengthen the compute scheduling platform; give compute-renting entities municipal rent subsidies of up to 30%, and joint municipal-district rent subsidies of up to 1 year and up to 100%; give up to 10% construction support for self-built compute facilities.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to entities that rent intelligent compute or deploy self-owned compute facilities, subject to the measure's support limits.

evidence.quote: 发放6亿元算力券 [issue 600 million yuan compute vouchers]

obligations.summary: Issue 300 million yuan of model vouchers; give subsidies of up to 50% of the approved contract value, up to 5 million yuan, for calling third-party large models on cloud platforms or privately deploying them.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to entities advancing vertical large-model applications, as specified in the measure.

evidence.quote: 给予核定合同额最高50%、最高500万元补贴

obligations.summary: Issue 100 million yuan of corpus vouchers and strengthen the corpus public service platform; give procurement subsidies of up to 30% of the approved contract value, up to 5 million yuan, for purchasing corpora from unrelated parties.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies to entities purchasing non-affiliated corpora for model, vertical application or agent R&D.

obligations.conditional_on: Support is based on approved project investment; the 50% tier requires municipal government approval.

obligations.conditional_on: Aspirational wording ('力争') for the 2-year target; funding applies to qualifying projects.

relations.note: The text names no legal instrument it is made under, amends, implements or cross-references. It cites the national strategy (国家发展新一代人工智能的战略部署) only as policy background.

definitions.note: The text defines no terms. Scope-relevant terms such as 人工智能企业, 符合条件的 and 非关联方 are used without definition.

enforcement.note: The text sets out subsidy, voucher and reward measures for AI application (computing-power, model, corpus and project support). It contains no fines, penalties, criminal sanctions, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension or blocking provisions, and no reference to a penalty regime.
